sourceKind: community reference, cross-checked with community shop catalog

dailyShop.note: Draft offers let you choose the alliance. Check Daily Deals slot 6; offer rarity varies. Catalog availability does not confirm today's stock.

forge.note: Each orb consumes 5 lower-rarity orbs of the same alliance and 1 forge badge of the output rarity, plus coins. Uncommon orbs cannot be forged. Forge suggestions use surplus after reserving the current plan. Forge badges and coins are not budgeted here.

sources.name: Onslaught · Honour Your Warriors
sources.note: Deploy and honour a character of the required alliance at an orb-producing progression stage. Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic characters at their last star before ascension can yield the next rarity's orb; Legendary characters below Legendary star can yield Legendary orbs. The sector determines the chance. Preview the reward before spending a token; the honouree can differ from the recipient. Legendary star itself is not a Legendary-orb farm; Legendary star and Mythic characters below Mythic wings can yield Mythic orbs.

sources.name: Guild Raid → Guild Credits → Guild Shop
sources.note: Earn Guild Credits through raid participation and reward crates, then buy a draft orb for the alliance you need. Orbs were removed from Guild Raid reward crates in August 2025; raids fund the shop rather than dropping orbs directly.

sources.name: Mythic Journey missions
sources.note: At Legendary star, a character unlocks a five-mission chain whose total rewards cover the 20 Mythic shards and 10 Mythic orbs for first ascension. Mission completion is not supplied by the account API.

sources.name: Requisitions, mission crates, Battle Pass and events
sources.note: Additional orbs can come from requisitions and eligible reward tracks or event offers. Random drops cannot guarantee your needed alliance or rarity; check current rewards in-game. Use draft rewards for the highest-priority shortfall. Event shops vary and old offers are not current stock.
